STEP 1 CREATE YOUR ACCOUNT
1 Go to anytime-soccer.com
2 Click "Join for Free" and fill out the registration form
3 Enter your Team Code during signup Check your email from your coach for the code
4 Open the Welcome Email and click "Verify Address" Don't see it? Check your spam or junk folder!
5 Log in with your email and password — you're in! Watch Video
STEP 2 ADD PLAYER PROFILE
1 From your dashboard, click "Add Profile"
2 Enter your player's name, age, and details
3 You can use the same contact email for all player profiles Add up to 4 player profiles per account
4 Click "Save" to complete the profile Watch Video
STEP 3 JOIN YOUR TEAM
1 Click "Login" next to your player's profile
2 Go to "MY TEAMS" in the navigation menu
3 Click "Join Team" and search for your team name
4 Click "Request to Join" — you're done! Your coach will approve the request, and you'll be ready to train Watch Video

Can't find your team? Try searching for part of the team name, or ask your coach for the exact name.

BONUS ALREADY HAVE AN ACCOUNT? APPLY TEAM CODE
1 Sign in to your existing account at anytime-soccer.com
2 Go to "Account Management" from your dashboard
3 Enter your Team Code and click "Apply" That's it — no need to click Save! Watch Video

Note: Team Codes unlock your subscription access. You'll still need to join your team separately (Step 3 above).

Information automatically collected

"data controller" means a person who (either alone or jointly or in common with other persons) determines the purposes for which and the manner in which any personal information are, or are to be used.

"data processor", in relation to personal information, means any person (other than an employee of the data controller) who processes the data on behalf of the data controller.

If you provide the data and the instructions, then you are the data controller and Anytime Online Training is the data processor.

If we determine the purposes for which we collect and use your personal information, then we are the Controller.

No purpose in this policy will require us keeping your personal information for longer than 1 year past the termination of the user's account.

We have implemented appropriate technical and organizational security measures designed to protect the security of any personal information we process. However, please also remember that we cannot guarantee that the internet itself is 100% secure.

9. WHAT ARE YOUR PRIVACY RIGHTS?

In some regions (like the European Economic Area), you have certain rights under applicable data protection laws. If you have questions or comments about your privacy rights, you may email us at info@anytime-soccer.com.

Opting out of email marketing: You can unsubscribe from our marketing email list at any time by clicking on the unsubscribe link in the emails that we send or by contacting us using the details provided below.

10. DATA BREACH

A privacy breach occurs when there is unauthorized access to or collection, use, disclosure or disposal of personal information. You will be notified about data breaches when Anytime Online Training believes you are likely to be at risk or serious harm. In the event that Anytime Online Training becomes aware of a security breach which has resulted or may result in unauthorized access, use or disclosure of personal information Anytime Online Training will promptly investigate the matter and notify the applicable Supervisory Authority not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it.

No uniform technology standard for recognizing and implementing DNT signals has been finalized. As such, we do not currently respond to DNT browser signals or any other mechanism that automatically communicates your choice not to be tracked online.

title: Lonestar 14G Red CTX Getting Started
content:
Parent Getting Started Guide

Follow these 3 simple steps to get your player training with Anytime Soccer Training

Team Name
Lonestar Soccer Club 14G Red CTX
Team Code
lonestar03112026
STEP 1 CREATE YOUR ACCOUNT
1 Go to anytime-soccer.com
2 Click "Join for Free" and fill out the registration form
3 Enter your Team Code during signup Check your email from your coach for the code
4 Open the Welcome Email and click "Verify Address" Don't see it? Check your spam or junk folder!
5 Log in with your email and password — you're in! Watch Video
STEP 2 ADD PLAYER PROFILE
1 From your dashboard, click "Add Profile"
2 Enter your player's name, age, and details
3 You can use the same contact email for all player profiles Add up to 4 player profiles per account
4 Click "Save" to complete the profile Watch Video
STEP 3 JOIN YOUR TEAM
1 Click "Login" next to your player's profile
2 Go to "MY TEAMS" in the navigation menu
3 Click "Join Team" and search for your team name
4 Click "Request to Join" — you're done! Your coach will approve the request, and you'll be ready to train Watch Video

Can't find your team? Try searching for part of the team name, or ask your coach for the exact name.

BONUS ALREADY HAVE AN ACCOUNT? APPLY TEAM CODE
1 Sign in to your existing account at anytime-soccer.com
2 Go to "Account Management" from your dashboard
3 Enter your Team Code and click "Apply" That's it — no need to click Save! Watch Video

Note: Team Codes unlock your subscription access. You'll still need to join your team separately (Step 3 above).

Need Help? We're Here for You!
